text.tspan: !!! STOP: 3 failed fix attempts in a row. Do NOT edit code now.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
text.tspan: !!! 1) .sci/sci hyp add "<specific, testable cause>" (at least 2 hypotheses)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
text.tspan: !!! 2) test each with a tiny experiment, not a code fix: .sci/sci run "python3 .sci/scratch/probe.py"

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
text.tspan: !!! 3) .sci/sci hyp refute H<n> "<evidence>" or .sci/sci hyp confirm H<n> "<evidence>"

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
text.tspan: !!! Then fix only the confirmed cause. Undo bad edits with: .sci/sci restore
